# DMTools

> DMTools is an open-source command-line orchestrator that connects AI agents to
> enterprise delivery systems. It exposes 320+ tools across 20+ integrations —
> Jira, Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitLab, Confluence, Figma, Microsoft Teams and
> every major AI provider — behind a single CLI. Built and maintained by EPAM
> Systems, released under Apache 2.0.

DMTools requires Java 17 or newer and installs with one command on Linux, macOS
and Windows. It runs no server and keeps no agent process alive: the CLI is
installed fresh on each run, which is what makes it safe to drop into CI. Every
tool is generated from annotated Java at compile time, so the CLI surface, the
MCP schema and the JavaScript functions available to agents never drift apart.

The same tool set is reachable four ways: direct CLI calls, MCP for assistants
such as Claude and Cursor, plain JavaScript functions inside jobs, and CI
pipelines on GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or Bitrise.

## Documentation

Served as HTML on this site, rendered from the same Markdown the DMTools agent
skill reads. Relative links, because this file is static and a fork publishes
under /<repo>/.

- [Documentation index](docs/): every reference page, grouped by section
- [Skill entry point](docs/skill/): how an AI agent installs and uses DMTools in a project
- [Installation](docs/references/installation/): install script, requirements, troubleshooting
- [Configuration](docs/references/configuration/): environment variables per integration and per AI provider
- [MCP tools reference](docs/references/mcp-tools/): every tool with its parameters, grouped by integration
- [Jobs](docs/references/jobs/): the job system and its configuration
- [Agents](docs/references/agents/javascript-agents/): JavaScript agents and orchestration
- [GitHub Actions teammate](docs/references/workflows/github-actions-teammate/): running DMTools on ticket state changes

## Integrations

- Trackers: Jira, Azure DevOps, Rally
- Source control: GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket
- Documentation: Confluence, SharePoint
- Design: Figma
- Collaboration: Microsoft Teams
- Testing: TestRail, Jira Xray
- CI/CD: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Bitrise
- AI providers: Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, Ollama, EPAM DIAL

## Cost

DMTools is free and open source under Apache 2.0. There is no paid tier, no
licence key and no account. You pay only your own AI provider and the delivery
tools you already licence; there is no DMTools-operated service in between.

- [Pricing](pricing.md): the same answer as data, for an agent comparing tools

  Relative on purpose. This file is static, so it cannot know the base path,
  and a fork publishes under /<repo>/ — a leading slash would point at the
  origin root and miss.
